verdict.rationale: An official MCP server is a fair axis for an MCP registry/connection platform, but the evidence does not show Smithery exposing its own MCP endpoint that agents can connect to. The /docs/use/connect page describes a REST interface for reaching third-party MCP servers, and Uplink only proxies a user's own server. The probe's bare assertion of an 'official MCP server' points at that same REST/Connect page, and Smithery's own shutdown notice says Connect and Toolbox stopped working on October 31, 2026.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
